article.question: How is Fast Cleaner different from Google Photos Free up space?

source.title: Free up space on your Android device
source.fact: Google’s warning refers to device copies. Its guide also explains that removed copies are unavailable in the built-in gallery and while offline.

article.claim_scope: Official guidance supports platform facts. Fast Cleaner descriptions rely on its developer disclosures and existing store/product assets; no independent performance or security test is claimed.
